title: A path into the codebase through Sequa AI
summary:
Contributor guidance gained a codebase-knowledge MCP link, the project catalog grew, and the Claude workflow got a tidy-up.

Contributor guidance now links to Sequa AI’s Pollinations codebase-knowledge MCP endpoint, making it easier to explore the project through an MCP client.

The project catalog gained entries including websim-pollinations-ai and Visiora. The website also gained a direct projects anchor and lists NavyAI and Nebius as supporters.

The Claude workflow now permits Sequa’s web-search tool in place of its previous web-search tool, and the separate automated Claude PR-review workflow was removed.

highlights.title: Explore the codebase with Sequa
highlights.text: Contributor guidance now includes Sequa AI’s Pollinations codebase-knowledge MCP endpoint for exploring the project through an MCP client. [Open the MCP endpoint](https://mcp.sequa.ai/v1/pollinations/contribute).
